bibl.title: The Account of Demosthenes' Suicide in P.Berol. inv. 13045, B II.
bibl.seg: Davide Amendola, The Account of Demosthenes' Suicide in P.Berol. inv. 13045, B II.
bibl.note: Argues that P. Berol. Inv. 13045 (= MP3 2102 + 2570; LDAB 6760), B II does not refer to Alexander's death as the first editor of the papyrus thought but to Demosthenes' suicide.
